summary: This round adds Phase 3: the marketing hostname and homepage can now be set separately from the primary origin, so the `west` stack serves go.gethalo.dev from staging's campaign table and redirects to https://gethalo.dev. A separate load-balancer-authorized certificate and exact certificate-map entry cover a hostname outside the stack's own domain. Both configuration paths validate the overrides against strict hostname and https-origin patterns. Temp config tests cover development and Cloud Run reads and the rejected malformed values. A new durable HTTP test covers a staging runtime managing a production-hostname campaign, isolation, Host ports, visitor query overrides and disabling. Tests pass, the only uncovered lines are Pulumi declarations with reasonable exemptions, and I found no defects.
